enchantments.tooltip: Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Deception +2: +2 Quality bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Sight Beyond Sight: You can see through all veils, piercing magical and mundane defenses alike. +5% Enhancement bonus to Dodge bypass.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
